H_efficientnet_paired_effects.question: Does preprocessing history affect matched deployment performance and sensitivity to preprocessing mismatch?
H_efficientnet_paired_effects.claim: EfficientNet-B0 shows mixed-sign DFD deployment differences but consistently positive history-by-test-input interaction across three matched seeds.
H_efficientnet_paired_effects.a: Primary fixed-B deployment contrast M2 minus M1 on all B-eligible videos, source and DFD domains.
H_efficientnet_paired_effects.b: Within-common-cohort interaction plus constituent input-switch effects show why a mixed deployment difference does not remove preprocessing mismatch.
